findings.location: Statement, first sentence: assumptions on Θ, φ, and V before the W2 convergence claim
findings.evidence: This batch-52 draft uses F from def-feature-measure-energy but states only that Θ is closed and convex and φ and Ṽ are bounded Lipschitz. These conditions do not ensure that Ω=R×Θ is an admissible feature domain or that Φ(w,θ)=wφ(θ) satisfies the feature-energy definition’s Fréchet differentiability hypothesis. Require the full feature-energy hypotheses for this model, or define the weaker energy locally and state its assumptions. This carrier is outside batch 51 and was not edited.
